latest_user_priority: 우리 정책 결과가 잘나오는 것이 중요; 비교군은 고정 참고
objective_order: All scheduled requests complete, urgent0.8s/normal2s, zero observed violations on every required development condition
Among feasible policies minimize API energy and AP mean; maximize reduction margins while retaining peak/180s residual losses
Preserve uncertainty and adverse seeds/conditions; do not select only successful requests
sequence: Complete simulator arithmetic/trace diagnosis and repair stage-transfer error that distorts our policy results
Freeze corrected simulator and our policy action/public-observation contracts
Train rolling+ATC+RL candidates; evaluate on separately sealed fresh synthetic input streams; use authorized industrial-engineering alternative if needed
our_policy_factors: ATC candidate ranking with time-varying estimated processing time
RL joint order/route/concurrency/short-WAIT decisions with nonpreemptive support masks
Deadline-feasibility estimates and uncertainty-aware shield; no universal worst-case guarantee without identified bounds
plant_repair_before_training: Fit/validate dispatch-admission-return-post-release transfer by measured thermal/peer context rather than blindly pooling all phase vectors
Diagnose shared-stage/tail nonlinear extrapolation and quantify model error vs predicted margin
Explicitly reject unimplemented route-policy IDs; distinguish known route capability from exercised policy support
public_observation_only: Arrived ready requests and announced absolute deadlines/priority
Known own dispatch/response/AVAILABLE history; delivered sensor values with completion times
Estimated durations/remaining times from frozen measured-data model; no future latent draw or actual future arrivals
baseline_work: Keep current FIFO/EDF fixed references and saved diagnostics; no baseline tuning or broadening as primary workstream

common_engine_adapter.plant: One source-bound JS plant for calibration, policy evaluation and future RL environment; no separately tuned per-experiment simulator
common_engine_adapter.RL_bridge: Visible Python training owner with a persistent Node plant RPC child, observations/actions only; every real plant reset registered before construction
common_engine_adapter.event_API: Advance to arrival/AVAILABLE/WAIT expiry; policy receives arrived requests, supported masks and completed/public sensor prefixes
common_engine_adapter.original_checkpoints: Preserve parent results; changed state/action/physics requires new source/output/budget and new training registration
common_engine_adapter.decision_overhead: Record host planning/NN wall time separately; device scheduling overhead remains unmeasured and requires grounded sensitivity, never silently assert measured zero

own_candidate_scope: Rolling+ATC joint constrained PPO with route/concurrency/short WAIT
ATC-guided residual PPO with the same public information and masks
Rolling deadline-constrained thermal/energy beam/MPC as authorized IE alternative if own RL advantage is insufficient
